kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتكربن (form IIq)
# أَتَكَرْبَنُ (ʔatakarbanu) /ʔa.ta.kar.ba.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَكَرْبَنَ (takarbana)
# أَتَكَرْبَنَ (ʔatakarbana) /ʔa.ta.kar.ba.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَرْبَنَ (takarbana)
# أَتَكَرْبَنْ (ʔatakarban) /ʔa.ta.kar.ban/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَكَرْبَنَ (takarbana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
